sloka: निविष्टमात्रे सैन्ये तु यथोद्देशं विनीतवत्।भरतो भ्रातरं वाक्यं शत्रुघ्नमिदमब्रवीत् ॥ २.९८.२॥
transliteration: niviṣṭamātre sainye tu yathoddeśaṁ vinītavat।bharato bhrātaraṁ vākyaṁ śatrughnamidamabravīt ॥ 2.98.2॥

translations.english: After the army encamped in the assigned places, Bharata said to his brother Satrughna thus:
